description:
A finding on a German paragraph renders its title, detail, and action in German (decision Q14). Rule ids stay English. The catalog gains a German wording per rule, and a German rule without wording fails a catalog test, the same as an English one today. The block lead line and the principle line stay in the language of the finding.

Acceptance.
1. A German finding renders fully in German and an English one fully in English, in one report.
2. Claude Code, Codex, and OMP show the same text.
title: German finding messages and rule catalog wording
